text: Your dog will never tell you what it believes. So an AI twin of your pet can't be built from opinions or values. It can only be built from what your pet actually does.
An old Chinese saying: judge by deeds, not by the heart.
So you share a moment: a photo, and a few words. Coco keeps only what really happened.
Each memory earns points. Points open packs that turn memories into cards, and sometimes a new move falls out.
Ask where she likes to sleep, and she answers from the moments behind it.
Ask about something she's never been shown, and she says so, instead of making it up.
cocoverse. A little universe for you and your pet.
